LanguageData.SE_Edu_PC_Animals.label: Study: The Wildlife Biologist (Animals)
LanguageData.SE_Edu_PC_Animals.description: Teaches colonists various skills by showing them non-erotic instructional videos and interactive games like RimWorld, Killing Floor and StarWars. Is 30% more effective compared to real work. Does however not teach how to be good at melee or ranged combat which should be practiced on living beings.
